overview: Danielle Balocca interviewed Medford mayoral candidate John Falco regarding his public service background, community involvement, and key policy priorities. Falco discussed proposals for education, municipal infrastructure, environmental sustainability, diversity initiatives, and management of federal relief funds.

items.title: Candidate Introduction
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca introduces mayoral candidate John Falco and reviews his educational, professional, and municipal government background.

items.title: Local Favorite Spots
items.summary: John Falco shares his fondness for local ice cream shops in Medford.

items.title: Path to Local Politics
items.summary: Falco describes how participating in the Medford Family Network led to his election to the Medford School Committee and later the Medford City Council.

items.title: Mayoral Policy Priorities
items.summary: Falco outlines primary goals for his campaign, including expanded school programming, road and sidewalk repairs, electric vehicle transition, affordable housing measures, and establishing a standalone diversity, inclusion, and equity office.

items.title: Community Appreciation
items.summary: Falco highlights civic engagement and volunteer efforts across Medford organizations, citing annual school supply drives.

items.title: Personal Insights and Communication
items.summary: Falco discusses learning home repair skills and emphasizes the importance of listening to residents' concerns during public meetings.

items.title: ARPA Funding and Administration
items.summary: Falco calls for hiring a chief financial officer and creating a public community process to allocate $48 million in American Rescue Plan Act funds.
